parameters.content:
## Threads Public Post, Reply & Profile Data Extractor

**Actor:** [Threads Public Post, Reply & Profile Data Extractor](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/threads-public-post-reply-and-profile-data)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/threads-public-post-reply-and-profile-data-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `usernames` (array)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `tag` (string)
- `postUrls` (array)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `includeProfileInfo` (boolean)
- `postedAfter` (string)
- `postedBefore` (string)
- `includeMediaUrls` (boolean)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `authorUsername` (Author Username)
- `postText` (Post Text)
- `publishedAt` (Published At)
- `likeCount` (Like Count)
- `commentCount` (Comment Count)
- `repostCount` (Repost Count)
- `quoteCount` (Quote Count)
- `shareCount` (Share Count)
- `mediaType` (Media Type)
- `postUrl` (Post Url)

description: Threads public post, reply scraper: runs the Threads Public Post, Reply & Profile Data Extractor Apify Actor, returns authorUsername, postText, likeCount, commentCount, shareCount and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
